payload.summary: Unbounded recursive delete in tests/ward-flow-chat-control.test.ts has no retry guard
payload.detail: An rmSync on a scratch path with recursive:true and no bounded retry, flagged by tests/test-runner-safety.test.ts. The same file already uses the retry-bounded shape elsewhere, so the fix is to copy the existing local template. Matters more than usual on a machine that has been dropping shell commands. Reproduced at fb17db7b1.
